Priya Rao: Quick hypothetical — you get one two-minute superpower per day (works once, lasts exactly 2 minutes). What do you pick? Be specific (what you'd use it for).
Ava Park: Teleportation. 2 mins is more than enough to skip commute or grab lunch from home :raised_hands:
Sam T: Invisibility. Perfect for sneaking into that 2-min nap in the office couch :sleeping:
Noah Li: Super-fast typing + flawless recall for 2 mins. Ship PRs in record time :rocket:
Devon K: Time-slowing for everyone else by 0.01x so I can savor the last cookie. but tbf teleport is sick
Jordan: Instant language fluency. 2 mins to power through a call in perfect Japanese then switch back :jp:
poll-bot: Reaction poll started — :zap: Teleport | :zzz: Nap | :keyboard: Turbo-typing | :ghost: Invisibility | :earth_americas: Language
Priya Rao: Love the cookie use-case, Devon. Also imagine using teleport to switch city-level meetings in one day.
Ava Park: @Sam T nap + invisibility combo would be OP though — you could nap in a meeting and no one would notice :sweat_smile:
Sam T: true, but I'd be using invis for the snack table at all-hands :eyes:
Noah Li: Debate: turbo-typing for 2 mins could mean finishing a week's backlog if you combine it with perfect recall
Jordan: Language fluency for interviews. 2 mins of flawless answers could change someone's career :thinking_face:
Priya Rao: OK also meta question — do these stack across days? (answers: yes, daily). If yes, teleport slowly winning.
Devon K: Daily cookie preservation then. settled.
Ava Park: Vote below with emoji! :thumbsup: teleport, :heart: nap, :smile: typing, :tada: invis, :raised_hands: language
Sam T: Done. :zzz:
Noah Li: Done. :keyboard:
Jordan: :raised_hands:
Priya Rao: Thanks for the fun answers — mental image of Sam at snack table on invis is priceless :joy:
Ava Park: This should be a team-building prompt at the next offsite
Priya Rao: Agreed. Tagging this for the next icebreaker list.
